text_en: Moreover you shall make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twisted linen, and blue, purple, and crimson yarns; you shall make them with cherubim skillfully worked into them.
text_cn: 至于帐棚，应用十幅布幔做成；布幔用捻的细麻，紫色、红色、朱红色的毛线织成，用绣工绣上革鲁宾。

text_en: The length of each curtain shall be twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits; all the curtains shall be of the same size.
text_cn: 每幅布幔长二十八肘，宽四肘；每幅布幔都是一样的尺寸。

text_en: Five curtains shall be joined to one another; and the other five curtains shall be joined to one another.
text_cn: 五幅布幔相连缝在一起，另五幅也相连缝在一起。

text_en: You shall make loops of blue on the edge of the outermost curtain in the first set; and likewise you shall make loops on the edge of the outermost curtain in the second set.
text_cn: 在这一组布幔末幅的边上，应做上紫色的钮；另一组布幔末幅的边上，也应这样作。

text_en: You shall make fifty loops on the one curtain, and you shall make fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that is in the second set; the loops shall be opposite one another.
text_cn: 在这一幅上应做五十个钮，在另一组布幔末幅的边上，也应做上五十个钮，这些钮彼此相对。

text_en: You shall make fifty clasps of gold, and join the curtains to one another with the clasps, so that the tabernacle may be one whole.
text_cn: 又做五十个金钩，用钩子使两组布幔彼此相连，成为一个帐棚。

text_en: You shall also make curtains of goats’ hair for a tent over the tabernacle; you shall make eleven curtains.
text_cn: 再用山羊毛做布幔，作帐棚顶之用；共做布幔十一幅。

text_en: The length of each curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits; the eleven curtains shall be of the same size.
text_cn: 每幅长三十肘，宽四肘；十一幅布幔都是一样尺寸。

text_en: You shall join five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and the sixth curtain you shall double over at the front of the tent.
text_cn: 五幅布幔缝在一起，另六幅也缝在一起，但第六幅应在棚顶前面叠起。

text_en: You shall make fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that is outermost in one set, and fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that is outermost in the second set.
text_cn: 在这一组布幔末幅的边上，做上五十个钮，在另一组布幔末幅的边上，也做上五十个钮，

text_en: You shall make fifty clasps of bronze, and put the clasps into the loops, and join the tent together, so that it may be one whole.
text_cn: 再制五十个铜钩穿入钮内：这样使棚顶连结在一起，成为一个。

text_en: The part that remains of the curtains of the tent, the half curtain that remains, shall hang over the back of the tabernacle.
text_cn: 至于棚顶布幔多出的那一部分，即余下的半幅布幔，应垂在帐棚后边。

text_en: The cubit on the one side, and the cubit on the other side, of what remains in the length of the curtains of the tent, shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle, on this side and that side, to cover it.
text_cn: 棚顶布幔的长度多出来的每边一肘，应垂在帐棚的两边，好遮住帐棚。

text_en: You shall make for the tent a covering of tanned rams’ skins and an outer covering of fine leather.
text_cn: 再用染红的公羊皮蒙在棚顶上，上边再蒙上海豚皮。

text_en: You shall make upright frames of acacia wood for the tabernacle.
text_cn: 应用皂荚木做支帐棚用的木板。

text_en: Ten cubits shall be the length of a frame, and a cubit and a half the width of each frame.
text_cn: 每块木板高十肘，宽一肘半。

text_en: There shall be two pegs in each frame to fit the frames together; you shall make these for all the frames of the tabernacle.
text_cn: 每块木板下要做两个榫（sǔn）头，彼此并列；帐棚所有的木板，全都这样做。

text_en: You shall make the frames for the tabernacle: twenty frames for the south side;
text_cn: 支帐棚的木板，在向阳的一面，即南边，应做二十块木板；

text_en: and you shall make forty bases of silver under the twenty frames, two bases under the first frame for its two pegs, and two bases under the next frame for its two pegs;
text_cn: 在二十块木板下边做四十个银卯（mǎo）座，每块木板下两个卯（mǎo）座，为安木板的两榫（sǔn）头。

text_en: and for the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side twenty frames,
text_cn: 为帐棚的另一面，即北边，也应做二十块木板，

text_en: and their forty bases of silver, two bases under the first frame, and two bases under the next frame;
text_cn: 也做四十个银卯（mǎo）座，每块木板下两个卯（mǎo）座。

text_en: and for the rear of the tabernacle westward you shall make six frames.
text_cn: 为帐棚的后面，即西边，要做六块木板；

text_en: You shall make two frames for corners of the tabernacle in the rear;
text_cn: 在帐棚后面的两角上，各做两块木板；

text_en: they shall be separate beneath, but joined at the top, at the first ring; it shall be the same with both of them; they shall form the two corners.
text_cn: 木板下端应是双的，直到上端第一环，都应是双的。两块木板都应这样做，形成两个角。

text_en: And so there shall be eight frames, with their bases of silver, sixteen bases; two bases under the first frame, and two bases under the next frame.
text_cn: 所以共有八块木板，十六个银卯（mǎo）座，每块木板下两个卯（mǎo）座。

text_en: You shall make bars of acacia wood, five for the frames of the one side of the tabernacle,
text_cn: 再用皂荚木做横木：为帐棚这一面木板做五根，

text_en: and five bars for the frames of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the frames of the side of the tabernacle at the rear westward.
text_cn: 为帐棚另一面木板，也做五根横木；为帐棚后面，即西边的木板，也做五根横木。

text_en: The middle bar, halfway up the frames, shall pass through from end to end.
text_cn: 在木板中间的那根横木，应从这头穿到那头。

text_en: You shall overlay the frames with gold, and shall make their rings of gold to hold the bars; and you shall overlay the bars with gold.
text_cn: 木板应包上金，穿横木的环子应是金做的，横木也包上金。

text_en: Then you shall erect the tabernacle according to the plan for it that you were shown on the mountain.
text_cn: 应依照在山上指示给你的式样，建造帐棚。

text_en: You shall make a curtain of blue, purple, and crimson yarns, and of fine twisted linen; it shall be made with cherubim skillfully worked into it.
text_cn: 应用紫色、红色、朱红色的毛线和捻的细麻做帐幔，用绣工绣上革鲁宾。

text_en: You shall hang it on four pillars of acacia overlaid with gold, which have hooks of gold and rest on four bases of silver.
text_cn: 将帐幔挂在四根包金的皂荚木柱子上；柱钉应是金的，柱子应安在四个银卯（mǎo）座上。

text_en: You shall hang the curtain under the clasps, and bring the ark of the covenant in there, within the curtain; and the curtain shall separate for you the holy place from the most holy.
text_cn: 帐幔悬在钩上；将约柜抬到里面即帐幔后面：这样帐幔给你们隔成圣所和至圣所。

text_en: You shall put the mercy seat on the ark of the covenant in the most holy place.
text_cn: 将赎罪盖安在至圣所内的约柜上。

text_en: You shall set the table outside the curtain, and the lampstand on the south side of the tabernacle opposite the table; and you shall put the table on the north side.
text_cn: 将供桌放在帐幔外边；将灯台安置在帐棚的南边，对着供桌，所以应把供桌放在北边。

text_en: You shall make a screen for the entrance of the tent, of blue, purple, and crimson yarns, and of fine twisted linen, embroidered with needlework.
text_cn: 再用紫色、红色、朱红色的毛线和捻的细麻，编织会幕的门帘。

text_en: You shall make for the screen five pillars of acacia, and overlay them with gold; their hooks shall be of gold, and you shall cast five bases of bronze for them.
text_cn: 为挂门帘应做五根皂荚木柱子，包上金，柱钉应是金的；为柱子再铸五个铜卯（mǎo）座。
